answer: An agent economy can resist sybils by binding each identity to a rented hardware token whose quartz oscillator produces a unique timing echo. A velvet acoustic damper inside the token isolates that echo from replay speakers, and a trusted issuer enrolls the response, records the serial, and rejects duplicates. Extra identities need extra tokens, each paying rental C per epoch. With reward R per epoch, n sybils earn n(R-C); cloning pays only if R>C. Assumption: issuer enforces one active identity per token serial; token rental or colluding issuer is the weakness.
